draftPlot.title: BrainGate T15 · human intracortical, non-public
draftPlot.scope: One human participant using an intracortical speech and cursor BCI at home. Approximate recording duration is based on reported BCI-use time; session data were saved except during privacy mode. Independent-use neural data and transcripts are non-public; figure and statistical summaries are public.

points.label: BrainGate T15 · independent speech and cursor BCI use
points.sourceTitle: Card et al. (2026) · Long-term independent use of an intracortical brain–computer interface for speech and cursor control
points.sourceRole: Reported BCI-use duration and recording/access methods
points.quote: As of 22.6 months after the implant surgery, he had accumulated more than 3,800 h of BCI use
points.note: Card et al. report >3,800 h of BCI use by participant T15. The plotted ≈3,800 h uses BCI-use time as an approximate recording-duration basis across speech and cursor operation. Methods state that session data were saved except during privacy mode; the exact retained recording duration is unspecified. Independent-use neural data and speech transcripts are withheld for participant privacy; figure and statistical summaries are public. Dated to June 15, 2026 publication.

recordingCoverage.detail: Participant T15 is the single human contributor to the reported >3,800 h of BCI use. The plotted ≈3,800 h is an approximate recording duration across speech and cursor operation. Session data were saved except during privacy mode; the exact retained recording duration is unspecified. Session counts matched to retained recordings are unreported.
